title: Return Store Credit Refunds and Marlowe Rewards Tier-Qualifying Spend
content:
How a member's refunds under Returns & Exchanges were paid decides how much of the reversed spend is deducted from their Marlowe Rewards tier-qualifying spend.

## The deduction

The refunds concerned are those issued on the member's returns in the 12 months ending on the handling date. They decide how much of the reversed spend in the tier-qualifying window (the reversed spend on reversal entries) is deducted.

| How those refunds were paid | Share of the reversed spend deducted |
|---|---|
| At least one refund was issued, and every one was paid as a new Return Store Credit | none (0 percent) |
| Some, but not all, were paid as a new Return Store Credit | half (50 percent) |
| Otherwise: none was paid as a new Return Store Credit, or no refund was issued in those 12 months | all (100 percent) |

A refund counts as paid as a new Return Store Credit when its refund entry shows it was paid to a newly issued Return Store Credit. A refund paid to an existing store credit, a card or a wallet does not count.

## Illustration (hypothetical window: qualifying spend 2000.00, reversed spend 300.00)

| Refunds in the 12 months | Reversed spend deducted | Spend after the deduction |
|---|---|---|
| two, both paid as a new Return Store Credit | 0.00 | 2000.00 |
| two, one paid as a new Return Store Credit and one to a card | 150.00 | 1850.00 |
| two, both paid to a card | 300.00 | 1700.00 |
| none | 300.00 | 1700.00 |
